200: The Storage Management WSP Spaces Runtime performance object consists of counters that show information about Storage Management WSP Spaces provider runtimes.
2000: The number of control dispatches elapsing between 0ms to 4ms.
2010: The number of control dispatches elapsing between 4ms to 16ms.
2020: The number of control dispatches elapsing between 16ms to 64ms.
2030: The number of control dispatches elapsing between 64ms to 256ms.
2040: The number of control dispatches elapsing between 256ms to 1s.
2050: The number of control dispatches elapsing between 1s to 4s.
2060: The number of control dispatches elapsing between 4s to 16s.
2070: The number of control dispatches elapsing between 16s to 1min.
2080: The number of control dispatches elapsing more than 1min.
